name: vk-mcp-server
description: Read and post to VK (VKontakte) — walls, communities, users, photos and stats.
long_description:
Connects an AI assistant to the VK (VKontakte) social network. Read walls, search users and communities, inspect members and reactions, pull community statistics, and — when you ask it to — publish posts, comments and photos.

Read-only tools are marked as such, so a client can run lookups freely while still asking before anything is posted, edited or deleted.

Needs a VK access token, which you can create from your VK account in about a minute.

vk_access_token.title: VK access token
vk_access_token.description: To let the assistant post, use a community token: open a community you manage → Manage → API usage → Access tokens → Create token, ticking wall, photos, stories, messages and manage. It never expires and needs no app. It posts, comments and publishes stories as the community; VK refuses it wall reads, so add the service key below for those. Full guide: https://github.com/bulatko/vk-mcp-server/blob/master/docs/SETUP.md

vk_service_key.title: VK service key (optional)
vk_service_key.description: The service key from your VK app's settings page. With it, reads the access token is refused (walls, under a community token) are made with the key. It is never used to write.

vk_timeout_ms.title: Request timeout (ms)
vk_timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for VK before giving up on a request.

tools.name: vk_users_get
tools.description: Look up VK users by numeric ID or short name (e.g. durov). Use this to resolve a name to an ID before calling other tools, or to check whether a profile is closed.

tools.name: vk_users_search
tools.description: Find VK users by name, optionally narrowed by city, country, sex or age. Returns matches with a total count; page through them with offset.

tools.name: vk_wall_get
tools.description: Read posts from a user or community wall, newest first. Pass domain for a short address (durov) or owner_id for a numeric one — negative for a community, positive for a person. Each post carries its likes, reposts, comments and views.

tools.name: vk_wall_post
tools.description: Publish a post on a wall. To post in a community, set owner_id to the community ID with a minus sign (-123) and from_group true, otherwise it appears as your personal post on the community wall. Attach media with the attachment string that vk_photos_upload_wall returns. Returns the new post_id.

tools.name: vk_wall_create_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a post. owner_id is negative for a community. Returns the new comment_id.

tools.name: vk_wall_get_by_id
tools.description: Fetch particular posts by their full IDs in {owner_id}_{post_id} form, e.g. -1_340393. Use it to re-read a post you already know about, such as one you just published.

tools.name: vk_wall_edit
tools.description: Replace the text or attachments of an existing post. owner_id is negative for a community. Editing overwrites the previous content, so pass the full new text rather than an addition.

tools.name: vk_wall_delete
tools.description: Delete a post from a wall. owner_id is negative for a community. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: vk_photos_upload_wall
tools.description: Upload a photo so it can be attached to a post. Takes a URL or a local file path, runs VK's three-step upload, and returns an attachment string like photo-1_2 to pass to vk_wall_post or vk_wall_edit. group_id is positive here, without the minus sign. Needs a full user token: VK refuses a community token here (error 27), and has no other way for one to attach a photo to a post.

tools.name: vk_stories_post_photo
tools.description: Publish a photo story on VK (three-step upload: get upload server, upload the photo, save). Posts a personal story, or a community one when group_id is set.

tools.name: vk_stories_post_video
tools.description: Publish a video story on VK (three-step upload: get upload server, upload the video, save). Posts a personal story, or a community one when group_id is set.

tools.name: vk_messages_get_conversations
tools.description: List the conversations in your community's inbox, newest first, with the last message of each and the names of the people in them. Use filter "unread" to see what is waiting for a reply. Needs a community token with the messages right.

tools.name: vk_messages_get_history
tools.description: Read the messages of one conversation in your community's inbox, newest first. peer_id is the person's user ID, as vk_messages_get_conversations shows it. Needs a community token with the messages right.

tools.name: vk_messages_send
tools.description: Send a message from your community to a person. VK only delivers to people who have written to the community or allowed it to message them. This reaches a real person: show the user the text before sending. Returns the new message_id.

tools.name: vk_messages_mark_as_read
tools.description: Mark every message in one conversation of your community's inbox as read, e.g. after answering it.

tools.name: vk_groups_search
tools.description: Find communities by keyword, optionally narrowed by type, country, city or sort order. Returns matches with a total count.

tools.name: vk_groups_get_members
tools.description: List the members of a community. Returns bare user IDs unless you ask for fields, in which case it returns profiles. Many communities hide their member list, which comes back as an access error rather than an empty list.

tools.name: vk_groups_join
tools.description: Join a community as the token owner, or send a join request if it is closed. group_id is positive here, without the minus sign.

tools.name: vk_groups_get
tools.description: List the communities the token owner belongs to. Needs a user token — a community or service token cannot answer this.

tools.name: vk_groups_get_by_id
tools.description: Look up communities by numeric ID or short name (e.g. apiclub). Use it to resolve a name to an ID, or to read the description, member count and type before deciding what to do with it.

tools.name: vk_friends_get
tools.description: List a user's friends. Returns bare IDs unless you ask for fields. Needs a user token, and only works for profiles that expose their friend list.

tools.name: vk_newsfeed_get
tools.description: Read the token owner's own newsfeed. Needs a user token — this is the feed of the account the token belongs to, not a public one.

tools.name: vk_stats_get
tools.description: Read a community's statistics by period: reach, visitors and activity. The token owner must be an administrator of that community, otherwise VK denies access.

tools.name: vk_likes_get
tools.description: List the users who liked or reacted to an object — a post, comment, photo or video — with counts per reaction. owner_id is negative for a community; item_id is the post or object ID.

tools.name: vk_photos_get
tools.description: List photos from an album. album_id accepts wall, profile or saved as well as a numeric album ID. owner_id is negative for a community.
